desc:
[IMPORTANT] This isn’t AI slop it’s for players who cannot buy the actual game ❤️ 
GAME HAS LOW RATING DUE TO IT BEING TOO HARD BUT HAS BEEN FIXED

🌊 INFINITE SHIFT 🌊

You clocked in for the night shift at Level 37: The Poolrooms, an endless maze of tiled halls and flooded rooms. Something lives in the water. 🦈

👷 Form a crew of up to 4 and step onto a lobby circle to start your shift. Every crew gets its own server.

🔢 Solve 6 challenge chambers across 3 flooded floors to find the vault code.
🚪 Find the hidden vault, enter the code and ESCAPE TOGETHER.

⚠️ STAY OUT OF THE WATER.
👁️ The Undertow hunts by sound. Every splash gives you away.
🕷️ Watch the ceiling... it climbs.
💀 One touch in the water and you're gone.

🎒 Grab useful items, revive your crew and race the clock.
🦆 Unlock FREE cosmetics: flamingo floats, ducky shoes, snorkels and more!
🏆 Climb the leaderboards with full-crew escapes.

👍 Like and ⭐ Favourite for updates!
